entries.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
entries.description: Free, confidential support around the clock for anyone in suicidal crisis or emotional distress, or worried about someone else. Reach a trained crisis counselor by phone, text or online chat.
notes: Veterans and service members: dial 988, then press 1 (Veterans Crisis Line).
Spanish: dial 988 and press 2, or text AYUDA to 988.
TTY users can dial 711, then 988.
LGBTQI+ people under 25 (in this adult-only app, ages 18-24): press 3. This option ended in July 2025 and was reported restored in late September 2026; confirm before relying on it.
entries.verification: 988 number and 988lifeline.org URL confirmed 2026-11-26 in SAMHSA's FindTreatment.gov application (fetched directly). Text, chat, press-1/2/3 and TTY details cross-checked by web search only; 988lifeline.org was not reachable from the build sandbox.

sources.title: SAMHSA statement on the 988 Press 3 option

entries.name: 988 Lifeline en español
entries.description: Spanish-language crisis support from the 988 Lifeline by phone, text or chat, with counselors who speak Spanish.
entries.verification: Spanish page URL confirmed 2026-11-26 as linked from SAMHSA's FindTreatment.gov application. Press-2 and AYUDA text keyword cross-checked by web search only.

entries.name: 988 Lifeline for Deaf and hard of hearing callers (ASL videophone)
entries.description: Crisis support in American Sign Language by videophone, plus text, chat and relay options for Deaf, hard of hearing and DeafBlind people.
entries.phoneNote: Dial 988 from a videophone, or use the ASL Now option on the 988 website
notes: TTY users can dial 711, then 988.
entries.verification: ASL videophone service (launched September 2023) and page URL cross-checked by web search only; 988lifeline.org was not reachable from the build sandbox.

entries.name: Veterans Crisis Line
entries.description: Confidential crisis support for veterans, service members, National Guard and Reserve members, and the people who support them. Callers do not need to be enrolled in VA benefits or health care.
entries.verification: 988-press-1, text 838255 and chat cross-checked by web search against veteranscrisisline.net and VA pages; the site was not reachable from the build sandbox.

entries.name: Vet Center Call Center
entries.description: Talk with a fellow combat veteran or a family member of a veteran about readjustment, and get connected to a local Vet Center for free, confidential counseling.
entries.verification: Number taken from prior knowledge of VA materials; not checked online on 2026-11-26 (vetcenter.va.gov not reachable from the build sandbox). Confirm before release.

entries.name: Crisis Text Line
entries.description: Free text-message support with a trained volunteer crisis counselor, for any kind of distress, in English or Spanish.
entries.verification: Keyword HOME and short code 741741 (US and Puerto Rico) cross-checked by web search against crisistextline.org; the site was not reachable from the build sandbox.

entries.name: SAMHSA National Helpline
entries.description: Free, confidential treatment referral and information service for people and families facing mental health or substance use concerns, in English and Spanish. It does not provide counseling.
notes: 42 CFR Part 2 prohibits unauthorized use or disclosure of these records.
entries.verification: Number (tel:1-800-662-4357, '1-800-662-HELP') and page URL confirmed 2026-11-26 in SAMHSA's FindTreatment.gov application, fetched directly from findtreatment.gov.

entries.name: SAMHSA Disaster Distress Helpline
entries.description: Crisis counseling for emotional distress related to natural or human-caused disasters, by call or text, for survivors, responders and anyone affected.
entries.verification: Page URL confirmed 2026-11-26 as linked from SAMHSA's FindTreatment.gov application. The number was not confirmed online (samhsa.gov not reachable from the build sandbox); confirm before release.

entries.name: NAMI HelpLine
entries.description: Free peer-support information line from the National Alliance on Mental Illness for people with mental health conditions, families and caregivers: resources, support groups and next steps. Not a crisis line.
notes: In a crisis, call or text 988.
entries.verification: Number, hours and text keyword cross-checked by web search against nami.org; some NAMI pages use other keywords for 62640. nami.org was not reachable from the build sandbox.

entries.name: Warmline directory (peer-run warmlines)
entries.description: Directory of free peer-run phone lines, by state, for people who want someone to talk to before things reach a crisis. Hours and eligibility vary by line.
notes: Warmlines are not crisis lines. For crisis support use 988 or 911.
entries.verification: Directory and operator (Warmline Advocacy Group) cross-checked by web search; warmline.org was not reachable from the build sandbox.

entries.name: FindTreatment.gov
entries.description: SAMHSA's official, confidential locator for state-licensed mental health and substance use treatment facilities, searchable by location, type of care and payment options.
entries.phoneNote: SAMHSA National Helpline for help with the search
notes: Facility details are self-reported and can be out of date. Call to confirm services, eligibility and availability.
42 CFR Part 2 prohibits unauthorized use or disclosure of these records.
entries.verification: Site, Developer Guide v1.12 and JSON locator fetched directly on 2026-11-26.

entries.name: Find a Health Center (HRSA)
entries.description: Official locator for HRSA-funded community health centers, which provide primary care, and often behavioral health and medication services, regardless of ability to pay, on a sliding fee scale based on income.
entries.cost: Sliding fee scale based on income
notes: Behavioral health services vary by site; call to confirm.
entries.verification: URL confirmed 2026-11-26 as linked from data.HRSA.gov (HRSA) and from SAMHSA's FindTreatment.gov application, both fetched directly. findahealthcenter.hrsa.gov itself was not reachable from the build sandbox.

entries.name: Open Path Collective
entries.description: Nonprofit network of therapists who offer reduced-fee sessions to people who need financial help, after a one-time membership fee.
entries.cost: One-time membership fee (listed as $65), then reduced session fees (listed as $40-$70 individual, $40-$80 couples/family, $30 with student interns)
notes: Fees can change; confirm on the Open Path site.
entries.verification: Fees cross-checked by web search against openpathcollective.org FAQ pages; third-party listings quote other ranges. Site not reachable from the build sandbox.

entries.name: Trans Lifeline
entries.description: Peer support line run by and for trans people, offering emotional and practical support without non-consensual intervention. It is not a general crisis line.
entries.hours: Limited hours (official site listed Mon-Fri, 10 a.m.-6 p.m. Pacific); check the site
entries.verification: US and Canada numbers and hours cross-checked by web search against translifeline.org; hours were reduced in 2024. Site not reachable from the build sandbox.

entries.name: The Trevor Project (LGBTQ+ young adults 18-24)
entries.description: Crisis support by phone, text and chat for LGBTQ+ young people. The service is for people under 25, so this adult-only app lists it for clients aged 18 to 24 only.
entries.audience: LGBTQ+ young adults aged 18-24 (the service serves young people under 25)
entries.verification: Number, text keyword and under-25 eligibility cross-checked by web search against thetrevorproject.org; site not reachable from the build sandbox.

entries.name: LGBT National Help Center: National Hotline
entries.description: Free, confidential peer support and local resource referrals for lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and questioning people of all ages.
entries.hours: Limited hours; check the site (schedules differ between listings)

entries.name: NPI Registry search (CMS)
entries.description: Public federal registry of health care providers. Search by taxonomy (for example Psychiatry) and location to confirm a provider's NPI, specialty and practice address.
notes: A listing is not an endorsement. Verify licensure with the state licensing board.
entries.verification: Search page and API fetched directly on 2026-11-26; the 'search' and 'provider-view/:npi' routes exist in the registry application.
